rounds.prompt: The Mona Lisa ___ by Leonardo da Vinci.
rounds.note: A finished past action, with the painter as agent: was + past participle + by.

rounds.prompt: A new hospital ___ in our town at the moment.
rounds.note: 'At the moment' → present continuous passive: is being + past participle.

rounds.prompt: English ___ all over the world.
rounds.note: A general fact → present simple passive.

rounds.prompt: ___ your car been repaired yet?
rounds.note: 'Yet' → present perfect: Has … been repaired?

rounds.prompt: The thieves ___ by the police yesterday.
rounds.note: Plural subject, finished time → were + past participle.

rounds.prompt: This letter must ___ today.
rounds.note: After a modal: be + past participle.

rounds.prompt: The results ___ (announce) next week.
rounds.note: Future passive: will be + past participle.

rounds.prompt: The bridge ___ (build) in 1998.
rounds.note: Finished past time → was + past participle.

rounds.prompt: My phone ___ (steal)! I can't find it anywhere.
rounds.note: A past action with a result now → has been + past participle.

rounds.prompt: The house ___ (paint) when we arrived.
rounds.note: In progress at a past moment → was being + past participle.

rounds.prompt: All the tickets ___ (sell) before the concert started.
rounds.note: Before another past event → had been + past participle.

rounds.prompt: This room ___ (clean) every day.
rounds.note: A routine → present simple passive.

rounds.prompt: The work should ___ (finish) by Friday.
rounds.note: Modal + be + past participle.

rounds.prompt: The new stadium ___ (open) next summer.
rounds.note: Future passive: will be opened (or is going to be opened).

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Subject + were + past participle + time.

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Has been + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Is being + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Modal + be + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Have + object + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Build the passive sentence.
rounds.note: Subject + is said + to be.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: The doors are locked at ten.
The film has been made in 2010.
rounds.answer: The film has been made in 2010.
rounds.note: A finished time (in 2010) needs the past simple: was made.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: The car is washing by my dad.
rounds.answer: The car is washing by my dad.
rounds.note: The car doesn't wash anything: it is being washed by my dad.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: It must to be done today.
rounds.answer: It must to be done today.
rounds.note: After must: be done, never to be.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: They had repaired their roof by a builder.
rounds.answer: They had repaired their roof by a builder.
rounds.note: Causative: they had their roof repaired (by a builder).

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: He is believed to be abroad.
She is said to be clever.
They are thought to have left.
rounds.note: Is said + to be: he is said to be rich.

rounds.prompt: Three are correct. Tap the one that isn’t.
options: A new bridge is being built.
The prizes will be given tomorrow.
rounds.note: The past participle of write is written: was written.

rounds.prompt: Active or passive?
rounds.note: Passive = be + past participle; the thing done comes first.

rounds.prompt: Continuous or perfect?
rounds.note: Continuous passive: being + past participle · perfect passive: been + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Correct or wrong?
rounds.note: After a modal: be + past participle — never being, been or to be.

rounds.prompt: Causative or passive?
rounds.note: Causative: have/get + object + past participle · passive: be + past participle.

rounds.prompt: Someone has stolen my wallet.
rounds.note: Present perfect passive: has been + past participle.

rounds.prompt: They are building a new school near my house.
rounds.stem: A new school ___ near my house.
rounds.note: Present continuous passive: is being + past participle.

rounds.prompt: A famous architect designed this museum.
rounds.note: Past simple passive, with the agent after by.

rounds.prompt: People say that the castle is haunted.
rounds.note: Reporting passive: is said to be.

rounds.prompt: A mechanic repaired my car last week.
rounds.note: Causative: had + object + past participle.

rounds.prompt: You must finish the report by Friday.
rounds.note: Modal passive: must be + past participle.

rounds.sentence: The film has been made in 2010.
rounds.note: A finished time (in 2010) needs the past simple: was made.
Letters is plural: were sent.

rounds.sentence: The road is repairing at the moment.
rounds.note: The road doesn't repair anything: it is being repaired.

rounds.sentence: This work must to be done today.
rounds.note: After must: be done, never to be.
The past participle of write is written.

rounds.sentence: He is said being very rich.
rounds.note: Is said + to be.

rounds.prompt: Match each active sentence to its passive.
rounds.note: The tense of be matches the tense of the active verb.

rounds.prompt: Match each form to its tense.
rounds.note: The form of be carries the tense; the past participle never changes.

rounds.prompt: Match each sentence to its reporting passive.
pairs: He is said to be rich.
He is said to have been rich.
He was said to be rich.
rounds.note: Now or then (is/was said); the same time or earlier (to be / to have been).

rounds.prompt: Match each sentence to its causative.
pairs: A hairdresser is cutting my hair.
A builder has repaired our roof.
rounds.note: Have + object + past participle, in the tense of the original.
